controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-13T10:10:06.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T11:10:06.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"

        AND (message LIKE "*session opened*" OR message LIKE "*session closed*")

| KEEP @timestamp, message, session_action, session_user, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC
